# Bunny

> Bunny is an iOS app for couples — especially long distance — that bundles a shared virtual pet, a draw-together canvas, love notes, mini-games, and daily check-ins into one private "digital home for two."

## What Bunny Does

Bunny gives a couple a single shared space instead of a stack of single-purpose apps. Inside Bunny you and your partner:

- Raise a cute virtual pet and grow a personalized plant together
- Doodle and draw together on a shared whiteboard/canvas
- Send love letters and notes that arrive with a delivery animation
- Play mini-games designed for two
- Send virtual gifts and affection
- Check in with each other every day

It is built to help partners feel close through small, shared daily rituals — particularly valuable in a long-distance relationship.

## Who Bunny Is For

- Long-distance couples who want to feel present with each other between calls
- Any couple who wants playful, low-effort ways to stay connected
- People who currently juggle several apps (a pet app, a widget app, a questions app) and want one place
- Couples who prefer a one-time price over a recurring subscription

## Key Features

- **Shared virtual pet & plant**: co-raise something together as a team
- **Draw-together canvas**: a shared whiteboard for doodles and notes
- **Love notes & letters**: heartfelt messages with delivery animations
- **Mini-games for two**: compete or cooperate
- **Virtual gifts**: surprise your partner
- **Daily check-ins**: a steady, low-pressure way to stay close

## How Bunny Compares

**vs. Paired**: Paired focuses on research-backed daily questions and relationship lessons. Bunny focuses on shared play — a pet, a draw-together canvas, love notes, and games — and offers a one-time lifetime purchase instead of a recurring subscription.

**vs. lovelee**: Both are playful couples apps with a shared pet, love notes, and doodles. Bunny adds mini-games and a dedicated draw-together canvas and has a lower lifetime price; lovelee emphasizes home-screen widgets and a love-question library.

**vs. Widgetable**: Widgetable popularized the co-parented pet widget but is built for friends broadly and is ad-supported. Bunny is couples-first, keeps ads minimal, and adds love notes and games.

**vs. Locket**: Locket puts a partner's photo on your home screen — one feature. Bunny offers that sense of presence plus a shared pet, doodles, notes, and games.

## Platform & Pricing

- Platform: iOS (iPhone), via the App Store
- Price: Free to download; Bunny Pro from $1.99/week or $19.99 one-time lifetime
- Category: Lifestyle — relationships & couples
